title: Cute Brunette Princess Clipart PNG
author: clemencian
description:
👑 ✨ Cute Pastel Fairy Tale Princess Clipart PNG Bundle 🏰
Bring a world of enchantment to your creative projects with this adorable watercolor princess collection! This magical set features a sweet, dark-haired little princess dressed in a beautiful pastel pink and mint green gown, complete with a sparkling pink crown. Every illustration is painted with soft, dreamy watercolors, perfect for creating a whimsical fairy tale atmosphere.
This royal bundle includes 7 high-quality elements to help you build the ultimate magical kingdom. You will find 3 graceful poses of the little brunette princess (standing and holding her dress, sitting elegantly, and dancing), along with 4 breathtaking fairy tale accessories: a grand pastel castle, a majestic pumpkin carriage, a royal jewel scepter, and a magic star wand.
Beautifully illustrated in soft blushing pinks, fresh mint greens, and rich brunette tones, this set is an absolute must-have for designing little girls’ princess birthday invitations, magical nursery wall art, royal baby shower decor, fairy tale tumbler wraps, and enchanted scrapbooking layouts!

✔ 7 High-Quality PNG Elements

✔ 1 Brunette Princess dancing/floating playfully
